title: benchhand sealed directory manifest (manifest.json), provisional
description: Provisional: the manifest.json of a sealed directory, a built version (hw/versions/<V>/) or a version-bound bundle such as hw/checks/<V>/<S>/, with only the keys the evidence service reads. Phase 2's versioning work (snapshot, seal and verify) owns this contract and extends it; until then every other key is accepted unread

files.description: sha256 of every file the directory holds apart from manifest.json, by its path relative to the directory

version_manifest_sha256.description: a bundle's binding to its build: the sha256 of hw/versions/<V>/manifest.json

parts.description: a built version's parts, by PN

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the model source the version built
